topic: Why Are Confident People Rarely Humble, and Humble People Rarely Confident?

slides.text: Why are confident people rarely humble, and humble people rarely confident?
Zoom out far enough, and your whole life looks *tiny*. That's humility.
Zoom back in, and you're the only you that will ever exist. That's confidence.
Hold both distances at once, and something rare happens.
Confidence and humility were never opposites.
